scope: Whole-flight classification and causal event annotation implementation
checks: Full 2401-point inference matches contiguous computational chunks with persistent memory
Future measurements cannot change earlier predictions
Fault truth and onset are absent from inference arguments
Training source normalization and independent-condition partitioning
Padding does not contribute to history
Healthy prefix, current state and record-level history have distinct targets
Event boundaries are estimates; confirmation times and unresolved labels are preserved
Old pre-fault alarms are not credited as new fault detection
Interrupted optimizer/RNG continuation matches uninterrupted CPU training
One prediction per entire flight and complete segment export
limitations: Original CSV/MAT sources and learned weights reside on the user machine and were not available for a formal training run here
CPU execution checks do not establish CUDA equivalence or fault-recognition performance
Default hyperparameters and event thresholds are unvalidated research starting points
Current native scope is healthy or one motor fault episode per record; multi-fault generalization has not been tested
